channel.title: Classifier | AI Engineering
channel.description: A 23-chapter handbook for Claude Code — permissions, context, skills, hooks, MCP and agents, worked out end to end for engineers who have to ship with it.

item.title: Permission Modes
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: Six modes decide what Claude Code runs without asking. The gate order they sit inside, how auto mode moves the check rather than removing it, and the handful of behaviours that surprise people.
